title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3903: 56% of contracts awarded and 54% disbursed as of 09 May 2025

MTR (medium term report) in September/October will be conducted when the EA has completed his internal re-organization: a) MTR will review scope and procurement plan based on recent institutional reforms for PPP, asset ownership; b) some packages are proposed to be repurposed. The AEFS monitoring and loan covenants compliance for 13 Toza Hududs may be only applicable for FY2022 and may not be covered for the succeeding year (because of the transfer of SWM responsibilities to private entities)–FM assessment is ongoing. Following MTR, the performance rating is expected to be "On-Track" in Q4 2023.
Progress Toward Outcome: To be determined.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51034/51034-002-apfs-en_1.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: A new institutional set-up has been proposed by the government where the implementing agency is changed from the dissolved Republican Association of Specialized Enterprises for Sanitary Cleaning (Association) to the newly-established Republican Center for the Organization of Sanitation Cleaning Works (Center). The executing agency's name has also been changed from the Ministry of Natural Resources to the Ministry of Ecology, Environment, and Climate Change. These proposed changes are under review, and once effected, the project implementation activities will continue.
